scientific_integrity: New work is the mixed parity correlation and joint sign cells. Previously known Newman/Coquet marginal results and standard carry methods are credited rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Multiplier 3 and dyadic prefixes only; no arbitrary-cutoff result. Complete earlier literature coverage, including possible implicit multiplicative digit-correlation formulas, remains an open bibliographic risk. The finite checker is not an infinite proof; the matrix derivation is the proof.
title: Exact oscillatory parity correlations at binary triples
